_comment: Every handle this project has probed and what came of it. Built at batch 42 after the validator caught a complete second record being written for a creator already in the dataset — the fourth instance of a stored fact being checked against memory instead of queried. check-handles.mjs cross-references this automatically, so the check happens at the moment of probing rather than depending on recall.
_schema: handle -> { status: listed | rejected | collision, why, at }. Listed entries are derived from the dataset at build time and need no maintenance; rejected and collision entries are appended when the rejection is made.
